description: This file provides helper functions for resource block (RB) and virtual resource block (VRB) conversions, as well as functions to find empty RB intervals, specifically for 3GPP LTE/NR scheduling support. It includes functions for converting CRB to VRB intervals based on 3GPP TS38.211 specifications, and utilities for identifying contiguous free RB ranges using bitmaps.

methods.name: crb_to_vrb_dl_non_interleaved
methods.description: Converts a CRB interval to a VRB interval for downlink, considering DCI format and search space type.

methods.name: crb_to_vrb_ul_non_interleaved
methods.description: Converts a CRB interval to a VRB interval for uplink.

methods.name: vrb_to_crb_ul_non_interleaved
methods.description: Converts a VRB interval back to a CRB interval for uplink.

methods.name: find_empty_interval_of_length
methods.description: Finds the largest contiguous interval of RBs set to zero, up to a specified maximum length, within search limits.
